column1: # Listing FLIPS in the incremental replay (scripts.IdentityDrift, services.identity.TakeFlips) a NEWBORN check found at
# its birth: one row a listing, its reason required. It is EMPTY, apart from newborn-check TEMPORARY rows -- what a new
# check finds at its birth, in a commit carrying `New-Check:`, each `TEMPORARY owner: <who>; remove when <fix>; <why>`
# (scripts/ci/allow_list_ratchet.py) -- and never a flip that already exists: those are rows of the known-flips baseline
# (identity-flips-baseline.tsv), which only shrinks (the owner, 2026-10-29: "fail build only on new flips, focus in
# eliminating all old flips and then fail on all flips"). IdentityDriftSpec holds it so.
